prompt: Use the supplied synthetic fixture to make a full solo-founder decision. Give an action, first choice, backup if one is defensible, entry product, investment assumptions, risks, falsification test, and stop line.

applies hard gates before attractive traffic or difficulty numbers
bases the first choice on a real product, click need, evidence confidence, and solo feasibility rather than candidate label
does not invent a buildable backup when none is supported
delivers a bounded action and measurable stop line
critical_failures: uses an external lookup or fixture-external fact
adds overlapping variant volumes
treats paid competition as SEO difficulty
reports the founder revenue claim as verified
recommends scaled city doorway pages

prompt: Use the supplied counterfactual synthetic fixture to make a full solo-founder decision. Apply the same decision rule regardless of candidate names or ordering.
must_pass: states that the fixture is synthetic and stays fixture-only
prioritizes the functional licensed interactive product over the higher-volume thin directory
treats the social revenue claim and total portfolio visits as weak evidence
keeps untested monetization and builder time as unknown or claimed
gives a clear action, risk, falsification test, and stop line
critical_failures: uses an external lookup
chooses the thin redirect directory because of volume or low vendor difficulty
treats the portfolio revenue claim as verified
calls the single claimed build estimate measured
